title: INSPECTION OPERATION 1
question: How does the manual facilitate the documentation and verification of inspection completion?
answer:
CAUTION: Incorrect use of solvent cleaners during panel replacement may lead to scratching on the wing root. Only use protective materials and ensure that ambient temperature is met before proceeding.

Operation 1 gives a list of item(s), which has all 50-hour interval inspection items and those 100- or 200-hour interval inspection items contained in the fuselage area. A general description of the inspection required and the Item Code Number for cross-reference to section 5-10-01 are shown. Frequently, the tasks define more specifically the scope and extent of each required inspection. These tasks are printed in the individual chapters of this manual.The right portion of each page gives space for the mechanic's and inspector's initials and remarks. A copy of these pages can be used as a checklist when these inspections are completed.
